source: Private-college 2025 cutoffs, General/Open, compiled Oct 2026. JEE-Main-admitting institutes use official closing CRLs where published (Thapar's 9 June 2025 cut-off notice, JIIT Noida's cut-off page) or percentile floors/reports converted with rank ~ (100-p)/100 x N, N = 15,30,000. That N is the percentile->rank mapping implied by Thapar's own rank/percentile pairs; NTA's official count is 14,75,103 unique candidates appeared across both JEE Main 2025 Paper-1 sessions (15,39,848 unique registered). Own-exam colleges (VITEEE, MET, SRMJEEE) use aggregator-compiled 2025 closing ranks (Collegedunia, Aakash, Careers360), since none of them publish official cutoffs; their JEE CRL equivalents (main_equiv) are estimates explained in each note. LPU, Chandigarh University and Amity are eligibility-based, with placeholder equivalents in the 8-11 lakh band. DA-IICT, Nirma and PDEU were left out because they publish only internal merit positions (e.g. PDEU Computer Engg 476, Nirma CSE merit no. ~1,133), not JEE CRLs. KIIT was left out because no genuine 2025 KIITEE data could be found (published '2025' figures repeat the 2015-17 numbers). Shiv Nadar and Bennett were left out because they publish only scholarship bands.

entries.college: Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore
entries.quota: All India, Fee Category 3 (VIT fee categories 1-5, 1 = cheapest/most competitive)
entries.note: CSE closed at 600 (Cat 1), 1,450 (Cat 2), 7,700 (Cat 3), 18,500 (Cat 4), 31,500 (Cat 5); Cat 3 used as the mid-fee representative (Cat 1 ~ JEE CRL ~5k, Cat 5 ~ ~78k). VIT publishes no official cut-offs; figure is Collegedunia's compiled 2025 Round-1 closing rank (VIT's 2024 table, with CSE Cat-1 548, is widely mislabelled as 2025). main_equiv uses a VITEEE->JEE CRL mapping (log-log interpolation through 1.5k->13k, 5k->30k, 10k->45k, 20k->60k, 30k->75k, 40k->95k, 50k->120k) triangulated from: pool ratio (JEE 14.75L vs ~2.5L VITEEE takers, Careers360 estimate, i.e. <=5.9x), Shiksha's 'VITEEE rank vs JEE percentile' article (99+ pct ~ VITEEE <1.5k; 95-97.4 pct ~ 15k-30k), noisy student-reported JEE/VITEEE pairs on Careers360 (multipliers 1.3x-7x), and the MIT Manipal MET-vs-JEE anchor (multiplier falls from ~8x at the top to ~5x lower down).

entries.college: Amity University, Noida
entries.note: No real cut-off: admission is on minimum 10+2 eligibility (about 60% PCM aggregate) via the university's own test/board marks, and JEE Main is optional. Because there is no closing rank, 'closing' just repeats the main_equiv placeholder, which was placed in the 8-12 lakh band from minimum eligibility. Amity ties JEE Main 2025 percentiles (90+) only to fast-track admission and scholarships; regular B.Tech admission is on 10+2 merit.

entries.college: Chandigarh University, Mohali
entries.note: No real cut-off: admission is on minimum 10+2 eligibility (about 60% PCM aggregate) via the university's own test/board marks, and JEE Main is optional. Because there is no closing rank, 'closing' just repeats the main_equiv placeholder, which was placed in the 8-12 lakh band from minimum eligibility. CSE needs >=60% in 10+2 with Physics and Maths (other branches 50%); CUCET is mainly a scholarship test, waived for >=90% boards or JEE rank <=50,000. Only the 2026 notice could be checked; 2025 assumed similar.
